issues.description: Problem statement requires implementing internal_calc as a private helper (explicitly: "nicht global"), but the solution repository exports internal_calc with a global directive. This contradicts the visibility requirement and may confuse students about whether the helper should be visible/exported or remain local. It also sets a different example than the assignment text, so students comparing their work to the provided solution might adopt the wrong visibility.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the solution match the assignment intent by removing the 'global internal_calc' directive from solution_repository/helloWorld.asm so internal_calc remains non-exported (private). Alternatively, if exporting is intended, update the problem statement to permit a global/internal_calc export.

issues.description: The template declares 'extern printf' (making the external symbol available), but the solution repository omits this extern declaration while still calling printf. This discrepancy is a structural/linkage mismatch: the solution may fail to assemble/link or at least differs in how external symbols are declared compared to the template, which can confuse students and prevent a straightforward build of the solution.
issues.suggested_fix: Add the missing 'extern printf' declaration to solution_repository/helloWorld.asm (matching the template) so external linkage is declared consistently and the solution assembles/links in the same manner as the template expects.
